blocks.text: Population ek hi species ke un afraad ka group hai jo ek hi waqt mein ek hi jughrafiyai ilaqe mein rehte hain. Species poori duniya mein jandaron ki ek “qism” ko kehte hain, jabke population kisi khaas jagah ke khaas group ko. Maslan Chitral Gol National Park mein rehne wale tamam Markhor mil kar ek population hain. Agar hum poore Pakistan ke Markhoron ki baat karein to yeh species ki baat hai; agar sirf Chitral ke Markhoron ki baat karein to yeh population ki baat hai.
